request.state:
Planned upgrade of the booking service, Saturday night.

The window was set at four hours. Work on the storage layer has taken longer
than we expected in rehearsal, so the window now runs to six hours. Bookings
will not be taken while the window is open. The desk will post an update when
the service is back.

q1.instructions: The notice leaves the upgrade window at risk of running longer than the plan it announced before.

criteria.true: The notice says the window runs longer than the earlier plan, or the notice does not settle the length at all.
criteria.false: The notice says the window runs no longer than the earlier plan.
